snippet.title: Sigils of Nightfall | Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Sigils of Nightfall is a roguelike deckbuilder where you fight for survival in turn-based battles, shaped by merciless decisions and resource management. Set in a gothic apocalyptic world inspired by the acclaimed tabletop RPG MÖRK BORG, every struggle is a slow descent into ruin.

You are a condemned soul, shackled within Mountain’s Penance, a dungeon of rot and despair. Beneath its stone veins, a cult festers, conducting blasphemous rites to awaken an entity that will devour the last light of the world, bringing about the Nightfall.

Play the demo and wishlist now
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3039980/Sigils_of_Nightfall/
